## Meso 0.2.5 Beta
This is a beta of the new Meso, rebuilt from the ground up, on its way to 0.3.0. It has had far less testing than 0.2.4: install it only if you're happy to report what breaks. For now it runs on Macs with Apple silicon only.
**Coming from 0.2.4** - The first time it opens, Meso brings over your settings, devices, buttons, keys, gestures and sequences, Time, usage statistics, Kindle export records and AI keys. - Everything 0.2.4 wrote is kept untouched in `~/Library/Application Support/Meso/Backups/Meso 0.2`. To go back, install 0.2.4 again and move those files back. - Not brought over: recipes, the menu bar layout, the downloader's list of past jobs, and a few actions the new Meso doesn't have yet.
**Updates** - This build follows the Beta channel and updates itself to later betas.
**New in this build** - Shelf: dropping a picture dragged from a web page no longer makes Meso quit. The last beta still did. - Plugins are ready as soon as Meso opens. Each one used to fail its first start and come back a moment later. - Open App, used on the app that's already in front, hides it without reporting that it didn't open. - Meso's log is much shorter: a computer that's away and unchanged trackpad gestures are no longer written every time.

## Meso 0.2.5 Beta

To go back, install 0.2.4 again and move those files back. - Not brought over: recipes, the menu bar layout, the downloader's list of past jobs, and a few actions the new Meso doesn't have yet.
**Updates** - This build follows the Beta channel and updates itself to later betas.
**New in this build** - Shelf: a picture dragged from a web page no longer disappears when the browser doesn't hand over its file. Its image goes on the shelf, or its link when there's no image. - The menu bar's cards for displays and this Mac match the other devices' cards, and a display's description stays on one line. - Clipboard's Shortcuts in Settings start with Open Clipboard, and there are five Paste Favorite actions instead of nine.

## Meso 0.2.5 Beta
This is a beta of the new Meso, rebuilt from the ground up, on its way to 0.3.0. It has had far less testing than 0.2.4: install it only if you're happy to report what breaks. For now it runs on Macs with Apple silicon only.

**Updates** - This build follows the Beta channel and updates itself to later betas.
**New in this build** - Disk Cleanup: on This Mac, the storage tile opens a page that draws your disk as squares and finds what can go: app caches, logs, Xcode data, package caches, project build folders, old downloads and large files. What you pick goes to the Trash, and nothing is deleted for good. - Screenshots can be edited: Edit (⌘E) on a screenshot's card sets its background, margin, corners and shadow. - The welcome tour asks for an invite code (a Mac that ran Meso 0.2 needs none), and its permissions step shows what each permission is for. - Meso's menu bar icon is the pebble from its app icon. - Another app's commands in the Does list carry that app's icon.
